translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Bangʼ mano, Ayub nowuoyo ka kwongʼo chiengʼ mane onywole.

content.text: “Mad chiengʼ mane onywolaeni lal nono,
kaachiel gi otieno mane owachie ni,
‘Onywol nyathi ma wuowi!’
Odiechiengno mad lokre mudho;
mad Nyasaye man malo kik dewe;
mad ler moro amora kik rieny kuome.
Mad odiechiengno otim luoch kendo mudho mandiwa oime;
boche polo mondo oume;
kendo wangʼ chiengʼ otim mudho.
Otienono, mad olal e mudho mandiwa;
kik obed kaka achiel kuom odiechienge mag higa,
kendo kik kwane kaka achiel kuom odiechienge mag dwe.
Mad otienono bed migumba;
mad kik winj koko moro amora mar mor e iye.
Mad joma kwongʼo odiechienge okwongʼ odiechiengno,
ma gin jogo molony gi luongo le manie nam miluongo ni Leviathan mawuogi.
Mad sulwege mokinyi lokre mudho;
mad piny mogeno ni biro ru tamre,
kendo kik one ka ugwe chako wangʼ,
nikech ne ok oloro dhoudi mag ii minwa
mondo ne kik nywola kendo ane chandruok makoro anenogi.
“Dine atho ei minwa,
kata dine obwoga ka inywola?
Angʼo momiyo minwa nopira e chonge
kendo adhodho thunde?
Nimar dikoro ayweyo gi kwe;
kendo dikoro anindo kendo ayweyo,
gi ruodhi kaachiel gi jongʼad rieko mag piny,
mane ogero kuondegi madongo mag dak matinde olokore gundni,
kaachiel gi joloch mane nigi dhahabu,
kendo mane opongʼo utegi gi fedha.
Koso angʼo mane omono panda ei liel ka nyathi monywol kosetho,
kata ka nyathi mayom mane ok oneno ler mar odiechiengʼ?
Kuno joma timbegi richo weyoe timbegigo,
kendo kuno joma ool yudoe yweyo.
Joma ni e twech kuno bende winjo maber;
nikech gionge gi nyapara ma chikogi kuno.
Jomatindo gi jomadongo ni kuno
kata wasumbini bende bedo maonge e bwo chik.
“Angʼo momiyo ichiwo ngima ne joma winjo malit,
kod ngima ne joma chunygi lit,
gigombo tho, to tho ok neg-gi,
adier, gidwaro tho moloyo mwandu mopandi,
gin joma opongʼ gi mor
kendo gibedo moil ka gitundo ei liel?
Angʼo momiyo owe ngʼato ka ngima
to yorene odinore,
ka ngʼatno Nyasaye ogengʼone koni gi koni?
Nikech kuyo kod ywak omona chiemo;
kendo chur ma achurgo chalo gi oula mabubni.
Gima ne aluoro ema koro osemaka;
gima ne aluoro mogik e ngimana ema koro osetimorena.
Aonge gi kwe, chunya chandore;
aonge yweyo, kendo thagruok lilo ema aneno.”
